description: Virto Commerce is an open-source platform for building extensible ecommerce applications. This includes complex digital commerce solutions for B2B, B2C, or B2B2C businesses, marketplaces, and derived SaaS commerce platforms.
rules: VirtoCommerce has edge (current, pre-production daily) and stable (production-ready, once in a quarter with hotfixes) releases. Always query the docs version matching the release you target.
